name: Learn basic kickboxing combinations
blurb: Adding legs to hands: teep, roundhouse and switch kicks, plus the balance to throw them without falling over. Hip rotation is everything.
gear: Shin guards if you strike a bag or pads
steps: Learn the teep or push kick, the range-control tool: knee up first, then extend, then retract to stance.
Learn the roundhouse: step out on the support foot, turn the hip fully over, strike with the shin rather than the foot.
Practise the return. A kick that does not come back leaves you off balance and exposed.
Learn the switch kick to throw with the lead leg.
Drill hand-to-leg combinations: 1-2-low kick, jab-teep, cross-roundhouse.
Do three-minute rounds combining hands, kicks and movement.
tips: Turn the support foot before the kick lands or your knee takes the torque.
Condition your shins gradually with bag work over months, never by hitting hard objects.
proof: Three rounds throwing balanced kicks in combination, recovering to stance every time.
